pages.name: Dark Threshold
pages.description: Up close, the shadow seems deeper than the stone. The sound of wind and distant ringing comes from it. A piece of white chalk lies on the step nearby.

pages.name: Unfamiliar Country
pages.description: For a moment, you find yourself beneath unfamiliar stars. Take one more step, and you are back on the staircase's upper landing.

pages.name: Relocated Door
pages.description: When the chalk outline closes, the shadow separates from the stone and rolls up like a dark carpet.

scenePatch.description: Only a white chalk rectangle remains on the last step.
